verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab has merge requests, its equivalent of pull requests: security findings appear in MRs, agents turn issues into MRs, and the GitHub importer brings over pull requests and review comments. Nothing documents forking a repository or outside contributors opening MRs from a fork back to the upstream project. Missing for 10: documentation of project forking, of cross-fork merge requests from external contributors, and of maintainer permission controls for outside contributions.
